reply.text: Electrolytes can help when you're sweating hard for a long stretch, like a long run in the heat or a session well over an hour. For most ordinary lifting days, food and plain water cover it. I can't give you an amount of sodium, since that depends on your sweat rate, your diet and your health, and it's a call for a doctor or dietitian, especially if you have blood pressure or kidney concerns. If you tell me what kind of sessions you're thinking of, I can talk through hydration in general terms around them.
